children: CBOT soybean November contract (SX26) may break a support at $13.04-1/2 per bushel, and fall into the $12.92 to $12.96-3/4 range.
The contract faces a strong resistance at $13.17-1/4. After failing multiple times to overcome this barrier, it appears to be exhausted, as a lower high and a lower low formed.
A break above $13.17-1/4 may lead to a gain into the $13.25-1/4 to $13.30 range. On the daily chart, a projection analysis on the uptrend from $11.65 reveals a similar resistance at $13.19-1/4.
The frequent appearance of hanging man and black candles around this level confirms an exhaustion of the rally. A correction toward $12.81-1/2 looks more likely than a rise toward $13.31-1/4.
